title: Integrating multimodal cancer data using deep latent variable path modelling

evidence_spans.quote: We introduce a method called deep latent variable path modelling
using breast cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas
Results from each of these data types can then be understood with reference to the same holistic model of illness.

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Original analysis of cancer datasets; the complete record contains no aging construct or aging-framed analysis.

identify synthetic lethal interactions using CRISPR–Cas9 screens derived from cell lines
